title: Ultimate Showdown
next_chapter_hook: Just as the commander of the Dimension Invaders dissipated, a trans-dimensional cold laugh pierced through the void—"You think this is the endgame? The Chess Player beyond the Primordial Chessboard has already made the final move."

text.content:
Three breaths.

Chen Ji stood quietly at the edge of the void rift, the fragments of the Tianji Record circulating slowly around him, emanating a cold light. The silence of three breaths stretched like three reincarnations. He could sense the trans-dimensional gaze of the Dimension Invaders' commander pressing upon him like something tangible—the arrogance of a hunter examining a caged beast.

Yet no one saw the faint, almost imperceptible curve at the corner of his lips.

The three breaths of silence had ended.

The Dimension Invaders' commander spoke with an icy, unwavering tone, as if reciting a pre-written judgment: "Since you chose to resist—let your name be etched upon the tombstone of civilization."

Before the words even faded, the entire void trembled. The boundaries of the Three Realms tore like silk gripped by an invisible hand, with rifts spreading in all directions. In the distance, the halls of Tianqing Sect began to crumble, the barriers of Xuanwu Sect shattered piece by piece, and even the forbidden lands of the Demonic Holy Sect started exposing themselves to the chaotic dimensional currents.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji slowly lifted his head, his eyes reflecting the collapsing laws of heaven, his voice almost mockingly composed: "Three breaths? How generous." He paused, then a cold smile curled at his lips: "Unfortunately, I've never accepted multiple-choice questions handed to me by others."

text.content:
The Dimension Invaders' commander hadn't anticipated such defiance from this "waste," and after a moment of silence, let out a disdainful laugh: "Interesting. Even beneath absolute power, there's still some insignificant creature daring to bare its fangs."

In the next instant, a devastating dimensional storm swept through everything. Where it passed, light was devoured, laws were crushed to dust, and the boundaries between time and space blurred beyond recognition. Chen Ji felt the spiritual energy around him dissolving like snow beneath the scorching sun.

Yet just as the storm threatened to consume him entirely, Chen Ji's eyes snapped open.

The fragments of the Tianji Record around him ignited into brilliant golden streams of light, coalescing behind him into a massive illusory Wheel of Fate. Across its surface, countless threads of cause and effect wove together, each one binding the destinies of all beings across the Three Realms.

"The Fate Weaver—" Chen Ji's voice emerged low and chilling: "Did you truly believe you were the only ones capable of rewriting the rules?"

choice.prompt: Facing the Dimension Invaders' full-dimensional attack, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.text: Resist head-on with the power of the Fate Weaver
choices.description: Consume a massive amount of Heavenly Fate Value, using the Tianji Record's power to directly "rewrite" the rules on the dimensional battlefield, engaging the invaders in a contest at the level of cosmic law
choices.risk_hint: After massive consumption of Heavenly Fate Value, severe backlash will follow, and the body may be unable to withstand it

text.content: Chen Ji formed seals with both hands, and the Tianji Record's illusory Wheel of Fate spun violently. Golden threads of causality transformed into countless blades that pierced directly into the heart of the dimensional storm. In that instant, the storm's trajectory warped under his intervention—the force that had been ravaging the Three Realms compressed and spiraled inward, forming a massive vortex.

The Dimension Invaders' commander narrowed his eyes, a flash of surprise crossing his face: "You can actually interfere with dimensional laws? Interesting... but you think that's sufficient?" He raised his hand, and a trans-dimensional beam of purple-black light shot forth, aimed directly at Chen Ji's Brow Center.

choices.text: Use himself as bait, detonate the Source of Heavenly Laws
choices.description: Proactively detonate the core rules of the Source of Heavenly Laws, sacrificing the current order of the Three Realms as the price, dragging the invaders into mutual annihilation
choices.visible_reward: Critically wound the Dimension Invaders' core consciousness
choices.risk_hint: After the Three Realms' laws reset, everything will change—all cultivation, memories, and personal relationships may be completely nullified

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter, a smile edged with desperate madness. He thrust the Tianji Record fragments directly into his chest, and golden light exploded outward from within him, spreading toward the heart of the Source of Heavenly Laws.

"Since you want this dimension—" Chen Ji's voice cut through the roar of collapsing laws, "then I'll bury it, and you along with it!" The Source of Heavenly Laws began violently shaking, countless chains of order snapping in the void, the foundations of the Three Realms visibly crumbling away.

choices.text: Activate Mo Xiansheng's sealed ultimate trump card
choices.description: Unleash the forbidden power Mo Xiansheng left deep within the Tianji Record, taking on the complete form of a Weaver of Fate to battle
choices.visible_reward: The complete form of the Fate Weaver, Combat Power temporarily increased tenfold
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng's hidden trump card involves ancient taboos; forcibly activating it may invite the gaze of the 'Eye of Heavenly Dao'

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, his consciousness sinking into the deepest part of the Tianji Record. There, a door long sealed trembled slightly. The voice of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul rang in his ear, carrying an unprecedented solemnity: 'Are you sure? Once this page is turned, there's no turning back.'

'There's never been a turning back.' Chen Ji reached out and pushed open that door. In an instant, a power as vast as the sea surged from within him. The fragments of the Tianji Record all unfolded, each page burning with the primordial light of fate. His aura swelled to a terrifying degree, causing even the commander of the dimensional invaders to step back involuntarily.

Regardless of Chen Ji's choice, the battle instantly intensified to white heat. The commander of the dimensional invaders finally wore a grave expression. He never imagined that an ant from a mere three-dimensional world could unleash such power. That purple-black beam collided violently with Chen Ji's Blade of Destiny, erupting with a shockwave capable of tearing through dimensions.

The entire Three Realms shook violently from this strike. Above the ruins of Tianqing Sect, countless disciples gazed up at that golden-purple light piercing through the clouds, an inexplicable awe and fear rising in their hearts. And in the distant Forbidden Grounds of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, Ye Qing's gaze snapped upward, his pupils contracting sharply: 'This is... the aura of the Fate Weaver?'

choices.text: Press the advantage, give the enemy no chance to catch their breath

text.content: Cold killing intent gleamed in Chen Ji's eyes as his hands formed seals once more. The Wheel of Destiny spun wildly, countless threads of causality transforming into a world-ending sword rain that poured down like a catastrophic flood upon the commander of the dimensional invaders. Each thread carried the power to rewrite fate; even one landing on someone could erase their very existence.

choices.text: Defend to attack, seeking the enemy's weakness
choices.description: Temporarily restrain attacks, construct a defensive barrier with the Power of Destiny, calmly observe weaknesses in the dimensional invaders' assault
choices.visible_cost: Passively endure part of the attack damage
choices.visible_reward: Pierce through the nature of the enemy's dimensional attack, obtain key intelligence for counterattack

text.content: Chen Ji did not pursue; instead, he dramatically stepped back three paces, formed seals with both hands, and the Wheel of Destiny transformed into a dazzling golden shield. The dimensional invaders' purple-black beam slammed violently into the shield, erupting with a deafening roar. Blood seeped from the corner of Chen Ji's mouth, yet a sharp gleam flickered in his eyes—he had seen through it.

choices.text: Call upon allies to encircle and destroy together
choices.description: Through the connection of the Tianji Record, summon allies from the Three Realms to jointly oppose the dimensional invaders
choices.visible_cost: Dispersing fate may weaken one's own attack power
choices.visible_reward: Allies such as Ye Qing and Han Lie come to support, forming a favorable multi-against-one situation
choices.risk_hint: Allies take time to arrive, and dispersing fate may lead to decreased overall Combat Power

text.content: Golden light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes as the pages of the Tianji Record flipped madly. Information streams raced through the threads of fate in all directions. Moments later, from rifts in the void, several powerful auras descended in succession—the demonic miasma of Ye Qing, the Xuanwu battle intent of Han Lie, and even the cool figure of Su Qingyao stepping through the air from the ruins of Tianqing Sect.

However, the commander of the dimensional invaders merely coldly smiled.

"Insignificant trick." He waved his hand, and the surrounding dimensional space folded abruptly. In an instant, Ye Qing's demonic path mist was forcibly isolated in another dimension, Han Lie's battle intent was weakened by an invisible force, and even Su Qingyao was pushed to the edge of the battlefield.

"Your battlefield is in three dimensions." The commander's voice was ice-cold. "But here—" He spread open his arms, endless purple-black dimensional power gathered around him, "—is my domain."

The Heavenly Dao Origin began to violently tremor.

Chen Ji's pupils constricted—he felt it. The foundations of the Three Realms were shaking. Those chains of rules maintaining the Three Realms' operation were breaking one by one. Cracks appeared in the sky, the earth began to fissure, and even time became chaotic. In the distance, disciples cried out beneath collapsing halls, elders tried to repair barriers to no avail.

"See?" The commander of dimensional invaders overlooked this apocalyptic scene, his voice carrying cruel delight. "This is the price of resistance."

Chen Ji lowered his head, looking at the slightly trembling Tianji Record Fragment in his hand.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's voice rang in his mind, carrying unprecedented gravity: "Child, once the Heavenly Dao Origin completely collapses, the Three Realms will cease to exist. You must make a choice—sacrifice yourself to maintain this tottering order, or let everything return to chaos?"

Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes. His sister Chen Nian was still waiting for him at the Holy Sect, Su Qingyao's trust had just been established, Ye Qing's alliance remained unfulfilled... He had far too many bonds, far too many concerns.

choice.prompt: At the critical moment when the Heavenly Dao Origin was about to collapse, Chen Ji had to make his final choice:

choices.text: Sacrifice the self, reshape Heavenly Dao with the power of destiny
choices.description: Burn all Heavenly Fate and the power of the Weaver of Destiny, forcibly mend the cracks in the Heavenly Dao Origin
choices.visible_cost: Chen Ji might completely dissipate within Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: The Heavenly Dao Origin is repaired, and the Three Realms are preserved
choices.risk_hint: This might mean the complete annihilation of Chen Ji's existence, never to be revived

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, burning with resolute light. He spread open his arms, and all the power of the Tianji Record surged from within him, transforming into countless golden threads that shot toward every crack in the Heavenly Dao Origin. "If my existence can purchase the peace of the Three Realms—" his voice echoed through the roar, "—then it is worth it!"

choices.text: Defy destiny and change fate, use the Tianji Record to rewrite the outcome of this invasion
choices.description: Attempt to use the Tianji Record's Foresight Ability to rewind the timeline, find the only possibility to defeat the dimensional invaders in the River of Destiny

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly bit through his tongue, spitting a mouthful of essence blood onto the Tianji Record. The fragment instantly transformed into a brilliant golden river, piercing through time and space. Chen Ji's consciousness was pulled into the depths of destiny, and countless future scenes flickered like a passing parade—he saw his own death, and also the dawn of victory.

choices.text: Confront the Eye of Heavenly Dao directly
choices.description: Abandon resistance against the dimensional invaders, directly summon and challenge the true mastermind behind the scenes—the Eye of Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: Face the true enemy directly, uncover the real source of the calamity befalling the Three Realms
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Dao is an existence beyond dimensions, its power far beyond what Chen Ji can currently contend with

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter, the sound carrying a desperate madness of burning one's bridges. "Dimensional invaders?" He abruptly raised his head, his gaze piercing through dimensional barriers as if gazing at some existence even higher. "Do you think you're the one playing this chess game?" He shouted toward the void. "Eye of Heavenly Dao—since you've always been watching, then come end this yourself!"

The moment Chen Ji made his choice, the commander of the dimensional invaders' expression suddenly changed drastically.

"You..." He abruptly looked up, his eyes showing true fear for the first time. That call piercing through dimensions was like thunder, causing the purple-black forces around him to scatter. "How dare you—how dare you disturb that one—"

Before he could finish, the entire battlefield suddenly froze.

Not from the dimensional invaders' power, but from some even more ancient, even more terrifying existence slowly awakening from the deepest depths of the Heavenly Dao Origin.

A massive crack tore open in the heavens.

Within that crack there was no light, no darkness, only void—a void transcending the boundary between existence and non-existence. An eye emerged from the void, its pupil as deep as the River of Destiny itself, slowly sweeping across the entire Three Realms.

The Eye of Heavenly Dao.

Chen Ji felt that gaze fall upon him, cold, examining, amused—like watching an ant finally escaping its cage. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying unprecedented gravity: "It has come... Are you certain this is what you want?"

The commander of the dimensional invaders actually stepped back rare, bowing respectfully toward that eye: "My lord, this ant does not know the height of heaven, and has disturbed your slumber—"

However, the Eye of Heavenly Dao paid him no heed.

That deep pupil turned toward Chen Ji, and information transcending language directly flooded his mind: "Interesting... You are the second being from the Three Realms to dare directly summon me. The first was the creator of this Tianji Record."

Chen Ji felt an irresistible pressure envelop his entire body. His Weaver of Destiny power, under the gaze of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, was like fireflies compared to the bright moon.

But Chen Ji did not retreat.

He slowly straightened his back, staring into that Eye of Heavenly Dao, a cold smile curling at the corner of his lips: "Since you have always been watching from the chessboard, you must have known the ending of this play long ago?"

The pupil of the Eye of Heavenly Dao slightly contracted, and after a moment, it actually emitted a low chuckle: "Known? This seat IS the chessboard itself. What you call the Tianji Record is nothing but a piece of flesh carved from my body."

These words struck Chen Ji's mind like thunder. The Tianji Record Fragment violently trembled, and Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a pained howl—so that was it. The true origin of the Tianji Record was actually...

The commander of the dimensional invaders saw the Eye of Heavenly Dao conversing with Chen Ji, his expression shifting uncertainly. He clearly hadn't expected this "waste" to attract such attention from that existence.

Just then, the Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice rang out again, carrying an eerie undertone: "However, this seat is quite curious—how do you plan to end this?" Its pupil reflected Chen Ji's struggling figure, "Will you accept the fate of becoming a chess piece, or..."

Its voice suddenly paused, then carried a hint of amusement: "Or will you continue this ridiculous 'rebellion'?"

However, at this critical moment, Chen Ji suddenly smiled.

That smile was neither despair nor madness, but a clarity that saw through everything. He slowly spoke, his voicecalm得近乎mocked: "Elder Eye of Heavenly Dao, you said the Tianji Record is a piece of flesh from your body—but have you ever wondered why this piece of flesh would generate a will of resistance itself?"

The Eye of Heavenly Dao's pupil violently contracted.

Chen Ji raised his hand, the Tianji Record Fragment swirling around his fingertips: "You are the chessboard, so all you see are chess pieces. But have you ever wondered—why did you fall into slumber? Why did the dimensional invaders choose this moment to attack?"

His voice suddenly turned cold: "The mastermind behind this chess game is probably not just you, right?"

The Eye of Heavenly Dao fell silent.

That silence was more terrifying than any pressure. Chen Ji sensed the emotions flowing within that eye—not anger, but a kind of... wariness?

The dimensional invaders' commander changed color drastically, urgent: "My lord, this beast speaks nonsense, clearly stalling for time—"

"Silence." The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice was cold.

The commander shuddered throughout, immediately falling silent.

The Eye of Heavenly Dao looked at Chen Ji again, and this time, there was a hint of genuine regard in its gaze: "You know more than I anticipated. But are you certain you want to continue down this path?" Its voice carried a meaningful warning, "Some truths, once known, cannot be undone."

Chen Ji stared directly at the Eye of Heavenly Dao without retreating an inch.

"The junior never intended to turn back." His voice was firm and powerful, "Since Elder asks how I plan to end this—then the junior will speak directly." He took a deep breath, and at this moment, the qi around him broke through some kind of constraint, "I want this chessboard—overturned."

As the words fell, the Tianji Record burst open, golden light intertwining with the cracks in Heavenly Dao's source. The entire Three Realms resonated like thunder, as if trembling for some imminent transformation.

And that Eye of Heavenly Dao finally showed a trace of genuine emotion—not anger, not contempt, but a smile almost like satisfaction.

"Overturn the chessboard?" The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice was deep and ancient, "For hundreds of millions of years, countless beings have struggled in the abyss of fate, attempting to break free from this predetermined path. They died heroically, raged desperately, or begged weakly—but no one has ever dared to say the words 'overturn the chessboard.'"

Its pupil reflected Chen Ji's figure, and that reflection strangely resonated with the text on the Tianji Record.

"What qualifies you?" the Eye of Heavenly Dao asked.

Chen Ji did not answer. He slowly raised the Tianji Record in his hand, and the text on the fragment was spontaneously evolving, transforming into a line of words he had never seen before—

"Heavenly secrets cannot be revealed; only those who break the mechanism may see them."

At this instant, Chen Ji understood.

The Tianji Record was not incomplete because it was damaged, but because its complete form was inherently—a key to breaking heavenly secrets. All previous holders of the Tianji Record tried to use it to foresee fate and conform to fate, never realizing that the true purpose of this divine book was to end fate itself.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying unprecedented excitement: "Child, you have finally found... the true use of the Tianji Record."

The dimensional invaders' commander was completely panicked.

He felt the qi around Chen Ji undergoing some qualitative change—not an accumulation of quantity, but a transformation of the Dao. This three-dimensional creature like an ant had actually touched the threshold beyond dimensions at this moment.

"My lord!" he urgently shouted, "If this person is not eliminated, he will become a great threat—"

"Clamorous." The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice was cold.

The next instant, a massive palm condensed from Heavenly Dao's rules reached out from the void, a gentle wave—the dimensional invaders' commander didn't even have time to scream before being crushed into countless dimensional fragments, dissipating into the void.

Chen Ji's pupils slightly constricted. Was this the true power of the Eye of Heavenly Dao? A single thought could destroy dimensions?

"Now," the Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice sounded beside Chen Ji's ear, "only you and I remain."

That enormous eye gazed at Chen Ji, its pupil's depths hiding endless star seas and reincarnations. "You just said you want to overturn the chessboard—this seat will give you a chance." Its voice carried an ancient sense of play, "Complete the trial I give you, prove you have the qualification to control this chess piece."

Chen Ji did not immediately answer. He knew the Eye of Heavenly Dao would never give him a chance for nothing. There must be deeper purposes in this.

But he also did not refuse. Because he knew this was the only opportunity he could grasp at present.

"What kind of trial?" Chen Ji asked.

A scene appeared in the Eye of Heavenly Dao's pupil—a chaotic void, a blurry figure sleeping within it. That figure's aura was ancient and powerful; even just a fleeting glimpse was enough to make Chen Ji feel suffocating pressure.

"Before the Great Beginning, there was a thing." The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice turned deep, "It is older than me, more ancient than dimensions. This seat thought it had long perished—until the dimensional invaders appeared, this seat realized it still exists."

Chen Ji's heart shook: "You mean... there is an even higher existence behind the dimensional invaders?"

The Eye of Heavenly Dao did not answer directly, only continuing: "The trial I give you is—find it, awaken it."

"Awaken?" Chen Ji frowned.

"Yes, awaken." The Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice carried a hint of complex emotion that was hard to detect, "It has slumbered too long and forgotten who it is. But this seat believes it is waiting for someone. Someone who can make it remember itself."

Chen Ji suddenly understood something. He looked down at the Tianji Record in his hand; the text on the fragment was faintly glowing, as if responding to something.

"You mean... the creator of the Tianji Record is related to that existence?"

The Eye of Heavenly Dao's pupil slightly contracted, as if recalling distant memories.

"The creator of the Tianji Record..." Its voice became ethereal, "He was the only opponent this seat ever acknowledged, and the only existence that could make this seat feel threatened. He tore apart a part of this seat and created the Tianji Record, solely to find that slumbering 'Primordial thing.'"

Chen Ji's heart surged with tremendous waves. The creator of the Tianji Record was actually searching for that existence from before the Great Beginning?

"Did he succeed?" Chen Ji pressed.

The Eye of Heavenly Dao was silent for a moment, then answered: "He found it, but did not awaken it. Because he discovered that the cost of awakening it would be the destruction of the entire Three Realms."

Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly.

"So your trial... is an impossible task?" His voice carried a hint of mockery, "Awakening it would destroy the Three Realms, not awakening it would mean defeating the dimensional invaders is impossible—"

"That is precisely why this seat needs you to solve this question." The Eye of Heavenly Dao interrupted him, "You are the new master of the Tianji Record, possessing its fragmentary power. Perhaps you can find a third path."

Its voice carried a meaningful anticipation: "Of course, you may also choose to refuse. Then this seat will take back the Tianji Record and erase all traces of you—including all your bonds in the Three Realms."

Threat. This was naked threat.

Chen Ji gripped the Tianji Record Fragment tightly, his knuckles white from the force. He knew the Eye of Heavenly Dao meant what it said—it had this ability. But he also knew this was not necessarily an opportunity.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind, carrying unprecedented seriousness: "Child, this is the critical turning point of your fate. Whatever you choose, be prepared to bear all consequences."

Chen Ji closed his eyes, countless images flashing through his mind—Su Qingyao's cold face, Ye Qing's demonic smile, Han Lie's unwilling gaze, Ling Yuan's sinister scheming, and his sister Chen Nian's blurry face...

Finally, he opened his eyes.

"I accept." Chen Ji's voice was calm and firm, "But I have one condition."

A playful glint flickered in the Eye of Heavenly Dao's pupil: "Speak."

"Whatever answer I find, you shall not interfere." Chen Ji stared directly into that enormous eye, "This is my trial, not your chess game. I will walk this path myself."

The Eye of Heavenly Dao was silent for a long time. That silence seemed to span the river of time, examining this small yet stubborn creature before it.

Finally, it spoke: "Very well. This seat agrees."

As the words fell, the Eye of Heavenly Dao began to slowly dissipate.

But before completely fading into the void, its voice rang out once more, carrying an inexplicable meaning: "By the way, there is one more thing. Although the dimensional invaders have been erased by this seat, the existence behind them—that 'Primordial thing' this seat mentioned—has already sensed your presence."

Chen Ji's heart tightened.

"In other words," the Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice grew farther but clearer, "from now on, you have been marked by it. It will appear at the most unexpected moments, in the most unexpected ways."

"As for whether it is enemy or ally—" the Eye of Heavenly Dao let out a meaningful light laugh, "that depends on your fate."

The Eye of Heavenly Dao completely dissipated.

The void returned to calm, dimensional rifts began to slowly heal, and the collapse of the Three Realms was temporarily halted by some invisible force. Chen Ji stood in place, the Tianji Record in his hand, yet his heart could not be at peace.

The Primordial thing from before the Great Beginning.
The true origin of the Tianji Record.
His sister Chen Nian's connection to the Heavenly Fate Lock Key.
The true purpose of the Eye of Heavenly Dao.

All of this was like a massive net, and he himself was stepping toward its center.

Just then, several figures broke through the air from the distance.

"Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao arrived first, her usually cold face showing rare anxiety, "Are you alright? That刚才那股imposing——" She saw Chen Ji was unharmed and slightly relaxed, but then furrowed her brow, "What happened? What was that Heavenly Eye?"

Ye Qing arrived closely behind, her demonic mist withdrawn, revealing that enchanting face. She looked at Chen Ji, complex light flickering in her eyes: "Fate Weaver... have you touched that level?"

Han Lie looked at Chen Ji with a complicated expression, as if wanting to speak but holding back. Finally, he just snorted coldly and turned away.

Chen Ji looked at the three people before him, a slight curve appearing at the corner of his lips.

"Nothing." he said nonchalantly, "I just had a chat with an old friend."

Su Qingyao clearly didn't believe it, but she didn't press further. She knew Chen Ji too well—this man always only showed the side he wanted to show.

Ye Qing gave Chen Ji a thoughtful glance, as if sensing something. But she didn't say more, only nodding slightly.

Chen Ji turned around, looking at the Tianqing Sect ruins being rebuilt in the distance, then at the already-quieted dimensional rift further away. His gaze was deep, as if gazing at some unattainable future.

"Chen Nian..." he murmured softly, "Wait for me."

He knew his sister Chen Nian being taken by the Holy Sect as the "Heavenly Fate Lock Key" was no coincidence. The Heavenly Fate Lock Key could disrupt the Tianji Record's foresight—and now he knew the Tianji Record's true origin. If Chen Nian had some connection to the Tianji Record, to that "Primordial thing"...

Then finding Chen Nian might be the key to solving all these mysteries.

Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his mind: "Child, you did well. But the road ahead will be more difficult than before. Are you ready?"

Chen Ji did not answer. He only tucked the Tianji Record into his chest, his gaze firm as he gazed toward the distant horizon.

Just then, a faint transmission came from deep within the Tianji Record.

That was Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul's final power fluctuation: "Child, the seventh page of the Tianji Record... has been unsealed. This page contains clues about the 'Primordial thing.' But I can only tell you this much—the rest of the road, you must walk yourself."

Chen Ji's heart stirred, and he dove his consciousness into the Tianji Record. Indeed, the seventh page had slowly emerged, its text ancient and obscure, but several keywords could be vaguely made out—

"Great Beginning... divided soul... Three Realms... unified..."

And a name, a name that made Chen Ji's pupils sharply contract—

"Chen."

The creator of the Tianji Record... had the surname Chen?

Chen Ji shuddered. Mo Xiansheng had said the creator of the Tianji Record tore apart a part of the Eye of Heavenly Dao and created the Tianji Record solely to find that slumbering Primordial thing. If the creator had the surname Chen...

Then was there some blood connection between him and the Chen family, with Chen Nian?

More importantly—was Chen Nian being taken by the Holy Sect really just because of her "Heavenly Fate Lock Key" identity? Or was it because she carried in her veins...

Chen Ji dared not think further. But in his heart, there was already a wild guess.

A guess足以颠覆整个三界认知的猜测.

Although the dimensional invaders were erased by the Eye of Heavenly Dao and the crisis in the Three Realms was temporarily resolved, Chen Ji knew this was merely the calm before the storm.

The Primordial thing had already sensed his existence.
The Eye of Heavenly Dao watched jealously from behind.
Ling Yuan's scheming had not been fully exposed.
His sister Chen Nian remained imprisoned in the depths of the Holy Sect.
And he himself had just been tasked with the trial of "awakening the Primordial thing."

This game of chess had only just begun.

Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, feeling the Tianji Record faintly pulsing with warmth against his chest. That sensation was like a heartbeat, resonating with his own.

"Bring it on." he said quietly, "Whoever you are, whatever you want—this game, I accept."

Just as the dimensional invaders' commander's form dissipated, a cold laugh transcending dimensions pierced through the void—

"Do you think this is the end?"

Chen Jiabruptly抬头，心头一凛。

"The true Chess Player beyond the Great Beginning's chessboard has already made their final move."

That voice had no source, yet seemed to come from all directions, and also from deep within Chen Ji's own mind. It was ancient, cold, carrying an suffocating pressure, yet strangely carrying a hint of... familiarity?

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

This voice... he seemed to have heard it somewhere before.
